name: Lovable
what: AI 'vibe-coding' platform that builds full-stack web apps and sites from natural-language prompts (formerly GPT Engineer).
homonym_note: Google News hits for 'Lovable' also catch the adjective in unrelated entertainment stories.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026) and on the archived visionaries.vc/portfolio page from the 2025-04-21 capture; TechCrunch names Visionaries Club in the Feb 2025 pre-Series A and among existing investors in the July 2025 Series A.
membership.quote: Also in the funding round were Visionaries Club, plus angel investors

entry.quote: raised $15 million in a pre-Series A round led by Creandum

funding_rounds.lead: Menlo Ventures and Scaleup Europe Fund

valuation.quote: raising another mega round at a $13.3 billion valuation

graduation.quote: $200 million Series A round led by Accel at a $1.8 billion valuation

notes: Entry: Visionaries is not in the Oct 2024 pre-seed (tech.eu and TFN 2024-10-07 name Hummingbird, byFounders and angels only), so its first round is the Feb 2025 $15M pre-Series A led by Creandum. A round named before the A counts as Seed by taxonomy (the Creandum sibling applies the same reading), which is why graduation is filled: the $200M Series A led by Accel (2025-07-17), in which Visionaries followed on ('existing investors, which include 20VC, byFounders, Creandum, Hummingbird, and Visionaries Club'). Whether Visionaries joined the Series B/C is not stated. Valuation: $13.3B at the Aug 2026 Series C, as in the Accel, Balderton, Creandum, 20VC, Khosla and Menlo siblings (earlier marks $1.8B Series A, $6.6B Series B). Founded 2023 (GPT Engineer open-source project; the company launched its product in 2024); founding year not re-cited from a first-party page, medium confidence. Focus: siblings split (Accel SaaS, Khosla Consumer & Marketplaces, others AI & Applied AI); AI & Applied AI kept since the AI app builder is the product.
